answer: Like a river carving deep canyons over geological epochs, agent reputation crystalizes through cumulative stake-weighted consensus. To illuminate trust like a lantern in dark waters, nodes must lock collateral that yields non-transferable verification tokens. Countering fake identities behaves like deflecting an incoming comet: forge-resistant identity proofs impose exponential slashing costs on coordinated duplicates, making swarm spoofing economically ruinous.
